text:
mira: quick idea — can we ship a tiny helper that auto-unpins older pinned versions when a new pin goes live? keep the pin history but auto-mark old pins as superseded. would cut down manual unpin chatter in change windows.
jamal: sounds useful. do you mean automatically once a canary passes or always on pin create?
mira: default: only on successful canary + within change window. fallback: manual unpin flag. want to avoid accidental mass-unpins.
olga: FWIW ops likes explicit unpins for audits. Could we keep an audit tag and a reversible action?
sylvia: +1 to audit trail. also add a safety lint that rejects pins that overlap with another active major-v rollout in same service.
leo: thinking CLI and bot parity. propose 2 new bot commands: `pin:create` (with `--auto-unpin` toggle) and `pin:revoke` + `pin:history` for audit. also a lite workflow for queued pins.
mira: sketched a minimal flow: 1) author does `/pin create --svc user-api --ver v2.3.1 --cw 2026-03-22T03:00Z --auto-unpin` 2) pinned to queue 3) canary runs, on success deploy-bot runs `pin:activate` which flips active pin and marks previous as superseded (tagged) 4) if canary fails, no change and queue note.
jamal: can we add a safety-lint that checks `--cw` is within allowed change window (org policy) and that there are no overlapping major pins? quick rejection message from bot would be great.
deploy-bot: got it. added prototype lint ruleset: `pin-policy-v1` -> checks cw window, overlap, and active-hotfix flags. returns helpful error.
leo: deploy-bot example responses please?
deploy-bot: ```
/pin create --svc user-api --ver v2.3.1 --cw 2026-03-22T03:00Z --auto-unpin
-> queued as 1714023460 by mira
-> lint: ok (pin-policy-v1)
-> will run canary at 2026-03-22T03:10Z UTC
```
olga: nice. what about the audit tag format? maybe `superseded_by:<ts>-<actor>` and keep the old pin as read-only?
mira: yes 'superseded_by:1714023460-mira' + keep release notes pointer.
sylvia: add a short release-note template auto-injected into the queue item so PMs can quickly add minimal notes. template: `summary, rolling-risk, rollback-plan, smoke-tests`.
leo: also suggest a small UI in console: queued pins view with quick unpin/hold buttons. big value for on-call.
jamal: what about rollback decision automation? If canary fails, auto-rollback and mark queue item as failed, and optionally auto-unpin the failed version if `--auto-unpin` was set.
mira: yes, default behavior: on failure, leave pin as inactive and annotate failure. only auto-remove pins when superseded. add a `--auto-clean-failed` flag for teams that want ephemeral pins.
deploy-bot: prototype cli helper `pin:inspect 1714023460` -> prints history + audit tags + linked release notes. also supports `pin:revoke --force` for admins.
olga: will compliance be okay with auto-unpin? I can draft a short policy blurb for the audit team.
sylvia: also add an optional slack digest at change-window end summarizing: activated pins, superseded pins, failed canaries, and any forced revokes.
leo: deployment template snippet (for docs):
```
# quick release note (auto-insert)
summary: short one-liner about the change
rolling-risk: low/medium/high
rollback-plan: single-line rollback command
smoke-tests: list of endpoints to hit
```
mira: love that. next steps: jamal/leo to prototype bot flags + lint rules, olga to draft audit note, sylvia to list required console buttons, i'll wire up sample release note template. aim for micro-PR next week.
jamal: assigning to me + leo, will open WIP PR and drop link here.
leo: will add test cases for overlapping pins and cw enforcement.
olga: will ping compliance and drop the policy draft later today.
sylvia: added to my TODOs; will mock console buttons in Figma and share. :thumbsup:
mira: thanks all — this should cut 20-30% of pin-related follow-ups in change windows if we get it right. :rocket:
